product_metadata.title: Lucid 3 Inch Mattress Topper Twin - Memory Foam Mattress Topper Twin - 5 Zone Gel Infusion - CertiPur Certified Foam
description: At Lucid, we make beds for the whole family— because when you wake up feeling your best, your family gets the best version of you too. The Lucid 3-inch 5-Zone Gel Memory Foam Mattress Topper is an affordable way to make a firm mattress plush. The three inches of responsive memory foam cradle your body with a soft “sink-in” feeling. This bed topper is gel infused to helps regulate body temperature by dissipating heat and the five comfort zones provide specialized plush comfort. Designed to fit, a Twin size mattress topper perfectly complements a Twin bed. Lucid mattress topper is CertiPur-US® Certified for safety and performance. For shipping convenience, the topper is shipped directly to your door in an easy-to-carry box. Comfort awaits.
